label: Hawk-Dove: the escalation probability p*C = V is invaded from neither side and costs the population
statement_en: For a symmetric Hawk-Dove contest with resource value V > 0, injury cost C > V and escalation probability p fixed by p*C = V (a named hypothesis), p lies strictly inside (0,1); Hawk and Dove have equal payoff against a population escalating with probability p; a population escalating less often than p gives Hawk a strictly higher payoff and one escalating more often gives Dove a strictly higher payoff, so p is invaded from neither side; and the payoff at p is strictly below V/2, the all-Dove payoff, which is the cost of conflict.

scope.basis: Symmetric pairwise contests, fixed V and C, no role asymmetries and no repeated interaction. With an asymmetry such as ownership the Bourgeois strategy is the ESS instead and this law does not apply. The theorem establishes first-order invasion resistance (the indifference condition and strict payoff ordering either side of p), not the full second-order ESS condition.
